+def _quotas(data):
+    jobs = data["jobs"]
+    blocked = set(data.get("blocked", []))
+    mandatory = set(data.get("mandatory", []))
+    options = [job for job in jobs if job["id"] not in blocked]
+    k = data["k"]
+    if len(mandatory) > k or not mandatory.issubset(
+            {job["id"] for job in options}):
+        return {"error": "impossible"}
+
+    quotas = data.get("quotas", {})
+    best_value = None
+    best_ids = None
+    for selected in itertools.combinations(options, k):
+        ids = sorted(job["id"] for job in selected)
+        if not mandatory.issubset(ids):
+            continue
+        counts = {}
+        for job in selected:
+            group = job["group"]
+            counts[group] = counts.get(group, 0) + 1
+        if any(not low <= counts.get(group, 0) <= high
+               for group, (low, high) in quotas.items()):
+            continue
+        ordered = sorted(selected, key=lambda job: (job["start"], job["end"]))
+        if any(ordered[i]["start"] < ordered[i - 1]["end"]
+               for i in range(1, len(ordered))):
+            continue
+        value = sum(job["value"] for job in selected)
+        if (best_value is None or value > best_value or
+                (value == best_value and ids < best_ids)):
+            best_value, best_ids = value, ids
+
+    if best_value is None:
+        return {"error": "impossible"}
+    return {"selected": best_ids, "value": best_value}
